drivingQuestion: What does 'they may not appear partially' mean?
outcomeNote: Rav Yosef's suggestion is rejected by Abaye in the next unit (chagigah.sugya020).

segments.he: וְאֵין נִרְאִין חֲצָאִין כּוּ׳. סָבַר רַב יוֹסֵף לְמֵימַר: מַאן דְּאִית לֵיהּ עֲשָׂרָה בָּנִים, לָא לִיסְּקוּ הָאִידָּנָא חַמְשָׁה וּלְמָחָר חַמְשָׁה.
segments.en: § Earlier the baraita taught: The people «may not appear partially,» as the verse states: “All your males” (Exodus 23:17). «Rav Yosef thought to say: One who has ten sons» should «not let five ascend now and» the other «five tomorrow.» Rather, they must all ascend to the Temple together.
